login.title: Sign in
login.hint: Same accounts as ONVIF and RTSP.
login.expired: Session ended — please sign in again

wizard.title: Setup wizard
wizard.hint: Ctrl+1…9 jumps sections. Hover a field for a tooltip and the ONVIF name.
wizard.auth_hint: In ONVIF Device Manager pick the same method. Default Digest also accepts Username token (ODM’s usual choice). Anonymous in ODM requires “none”.
wizard.tip_auth: Must match ODM: Digest, User name token, Basic, or Anonymous. Digest cameras accept Username token as well.

device.title: Device
device.name: Name
device.tip_tz: IANA TZ; DST is derived from zoneinfo

users.title: Users
users.hint: The same accounts serve the web UI, ONVIF and RTSP. admin is the main account: it cannot be deleted or disabled, only its password changes.
users.role_Administrator: full rights: every page, settings, users, all channels, PTZ.
users.role_Operator: watch video and snapshots (all or chosen channels) and control PTZ on them.
users.role_Viewer: watch video and snapshots only (all or chosen channels).
users.storage_hint: Passwords are stored encrypted in data/users.json. Forgot the admin password? Delete admin's "password" line in that file and restart: it becomes admin (or start with --reset-admin).
users.need_name_pw: Enter a name and a password
users.default_pw_warning: admin still has the default password (admin). Change it — anyone can sign in right now.

channels.title: Channels
channels.hint_upload: The file is copied next to the program (default video/). Assign it to a channel and Save.
channels.opt1: Option 1 — upload a file from the browser
channels.opt1_hint: The file is copied to the emulator's machine, folder
channels.opt2: Option 2 — a file already on the emulator's machine
channels.opt2_hint: No copy: enter the full path (e.g. D:\Video\camera.mp4) or pick it with Browse. The path is on the machine running the emulator, not where the browser is.
channels.opt3: Other sources: RTSP camera, HTTP/HLS, UDP, test pattern
channels.opt3_hint: Type and address are applied with Save at the bottom of the page.
channels.formats: Formats: MP4, M4V, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI, WMV, FLV, MPEG/MPG, VOB, TS/M2TS/MTS, 3GP, OGV, MXF and anything else FFmpeg reads. H.264 files (H.265 for an H.265 profile) are streamed without re-encoding; the rest (MPEG-2, Xvid/DivX, WMV, VP9, ProRes…) is re-encoded to H.264 automatically. The clip loops.
channels.no_file: Pick a file with the button next to it first.
channels.no_path: Enter a file path or pick one with Browse.
channels.net_error: connection dropped or the file is too large.
channels.playing: the channel now plays this file
channels.loop_hint: Loop and end action apply with Save at the bottom of the page.
channels.ended: The clip ended and the stream stopped (loop off). Restart channel plays it again.

ptz.title: PTZ
ptz.none: None of your channels has PTZ.

osd.title: OSD — text and picture on the video
osd.page_hint: Time, date and picture are burnt into every channel and profile (like a real camera). Changes apply with Save — streams restart for a couple of seconds. Time comes from the emulator PC's clock.
osd.hud_title: Service HUD (PTZ arrows, events, analytics boxes, relays)
osd.format_hint: %H hours, %M minutes, %S seconds, %I 12-hour, %p AM/PM, %d day, %m month, %Y year, %y 2-digit year, %b month name, %a weekday. Your own text is allowed.
osd.img_opt1: Option 1 — upload a picture from the browser (copied into osd/ beside the program)
osd.img_opt2: Option 2 — a picture already on the emulator's machine (path or Browse)
osd.img_key_tip: E.g. #FFFFFF turns the white background of a JPEG logo transparent. PNG alpha works without it.

security.title: Security
security.embed_rtsp_hint: Off by default. Enable only for legacy VMS that need rtsp://user:pass@host/…
security.tip: Applies to ONVIF, GUI /api, and optionally RTSP URI. Digest also accepts WS-UsernameToken for ODM.
security.opt_digest: HTTP Digest (ODM: Digest; Username token is also accepted)
security.accounts_hint: Users, passwords and roles are on the page

system.title: System
system.hint: GET /health — Docker liveness. SystemReboot via ONVIF.
system.log_tip: Select levels independently (not a threshold). Default: CRITICAL only. CLI: --log-level TRACE,INFO,ERROR or ALL / -v / -L / --log-dir
system.log_dir_tip: If set and log file is empty, write onvif-emulator.log into this directory.
system.log_console_tip: Mirror enabled levels to stderr (console build). CLI: --log-console / --no-log-console
system.auto_port: Auto-pick a free port at startup
system.auto_port_tip: If the ONVIF/GUI port is busy or reserved by Windows, take the next free one. CLI: --auto-port
system.port_tip: Applied immediately: the server starts listening on the new port and this page follows it. CLI: --onvif-port
system.port_error: Port change failed, still listening on the old port:
system.video_tip: Empty = video/ next to the program. CLI: --video-dir

cheats.title: Cheat sheets
cheats.exit_line: 0 ok · 1 config · 2 port · 3 missing dep · 4 runtime · 5 usage
cheats.web_sign_in: Web sign-in once per session (cookie), then every page without password prompts; an idle session ends after 12 hours.
cheats.web_reset: Reset the admin password: delete admin's "password" line in data/users.json and restart, or --reset-admin.
cheats.web_roles: Administrator — everything; Operator — watch own channels and PTZ; Viewer — watch own channels only.
cheats.web_api: Scripts: REST /api/* also takes Basic/Digest on every request; accounts — GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/users.

help.title: Help
help.connect: Connect: the ONVIF address, authentication mode, RTSP URI of every channel and profile (profile_N / _sub / _third), snapshots, ODM and VLC steps. The same without JavaScript: /info.
help.wizard: Wizard: authentication method (must match ODM), a new admin password, ONVIF and RTSP ports. CLI: --auth, --password, --onvif-port, --rtsp-port.
help.device: GetDeviceInformation / GetSystemDateAndTime. Manufacturer, Model, Firmware, Serial, HardwareId are returned to ODM as-is. Timezone is IANA (UTC, Europe/Moscow).
help.users: Users: roles Administrator / Operator / Viewer, channel limits, disabled accounts, password changes. The same accounts are checked by ONVIF (levels Administrator / Operator / User) and RTSP (allowed channels only). Passwords are encrypted in data/users.json.
help.channels: Each channel is an ONVIF profile plus a MediaMTX RTSP path. Uploads are copied into video/ next to the program (or video_dir). Source: file, RTSP, HTTP/HLS, UDP, testsrc. 1..64 channels.
help.ptz: Absolute / Relative / Continuous / Stop / Presets. Position is integrated at 20 Hz with no limit overshoot. GetStatus returns live pan/tilt/zoom.
help.imaging: Brightness/Contrast go to the FFmpeg eq filter. Iris/Focus are virtual servos.
help.osd: OSD: date and time stamps and a logo picture burnt into every channel and profile (format, position, size, colours, transparent background), plus the PTZ / event HUD. See docs/OSD_IMPAIR.md.
help.events: PullPoint: CreatePullPointSubscription → PullMessages. Topics: MotionAlarm, Tampering, FieldDetector. Modes timer/manual.
help.security: digest | basic | wsse | none. GetSystemDateAndTime is always anonymous (ONVIF spec). Digest also accepts WS-UsernameToken (ODM default). Accounts and roles are on the Users page.
help.system: Logs, /health, reboot (SystemReboot). YAML/JSON import-export. Video folder (CLI --video-dir). GUI language: ru (default) or en. CLI is always English.
help.hotkeys: F1 help · Ctrl+S save · Ctrl+E/I export/import · Ctrl+L log · Ctrl+Q quit · Ctrl+1..9 sections · Ctrl+K palette · Alt+arrows PTZ · Esc close
help.impair: Trouble: rain, noise, pixelation; shaking and covered lens (with Tampering events); packet loss, stutter, freezes, CBR / VBR spikes, narrow link; scheduled link outages (random interval). Bursts come at the end of every period. CLI: --impair 1:rain=0.6,shake=0.4,loss=3,outage=1-5m.
help.live: Live view: live video and snapshots of your channels in the browser, through the emulator itself (no separate MediaMTX sign-in).
help.diag: Diagnostics: relays, dry contacts, event rules with timers (fixed or random interval), analytics kinds, webhooks, a live log.
help.fleet: Fleet: several devices in one process on port ranges; export and import of the whole configuration.

connect.title: Connecting to the camera
connect.hint: The addresses below are exactly what the emulator hands to ONVIF clients (GetStreamUri, GetSnapshotUri). The host is taken from the address this page was opened with; pin it in System → Public host.
connect.auth_none: off (none) — no user name or password needed
connect.auth_same: that is your account; change your own password in the user menu (top right). The same accounts apply to ONVIF, RTSP, snapshots and the web UI (managed on the Users page)
connect.disc_on: on — the camera shows up in ODM after Refresh
connect.disc_off: off — add the device manually by its ONVIF address
connect.creds_in_uri: embedded in the RTSP URI (user:pass@host) — players will not prompt
connect.creds_prompt: not embedded — the player (VLC, ffplay) asks for user and password; or type rtsp://user:pass@host:port/path
connect.hls: Preview in a browser (through the emulator, same sign-in)
connect.more: All addresses, tokens and instructions are in Connect. The number of profiles (1–3) is set in the Channel constructor below.
connect.disabled: Channel disabled — it has no ONVIF profiles or RTSP streams.
connect.odm_1: Press Refresh — the emulator appears in the list (needs WS-Discovery on and the same subnet). If not, use Add and paste the ONVIF address from the table above.
connect.odm_2: Enter user name and password at the top left and press Log in. In digest mode the emulator accepts both ODM methods (HTTP Digest and WS-UsernameToken).
connect.odm_3: Select the device → Live video. Each emulator channel is a separate Video source and shows up as its own source in ODM.
connect.odm_4: Picking a profile (quality): Profiles → choose profile_N (main), profile_N_sub (medium) or profile_N_third (low), then Live video. N is the channel number.
connect.odm_5: ODM's Web page item opens an embedded Internet Explorer, which gets a simplified page with these addresses. Open the full UI in Chrome/Edge/Firefox.
connect.vlc_1: VLC: Media → Open Network Stream (Ctrl+N) → paste the RTSP URI of the channel and profile from the tables below.
connect.vlc_2: If VLC asks for a password, it is the ONVIF login. On dropouts force RTSP over TCP (Preferences → Input/Codecs → RTP over RTSP (TCP)).
connect.faq_1: ODM reports an authorization error — set Security mode to digest (or none for a test) and use the same user/password in ODM.
connect.faq_2: ONVIF works but no video — allow the RTSP port in Windows Firewall.
connect.faq_3: Addresses point to the wrong IP (VPN, several NICs) — set System → Public host.
connect.faq_4: The console and GUI builds (…-gui.exe) are the same program with the same web UI. The GUI build just has no console window: it opens the browser itself, lives in the tray and picks a free port.

impair.title: Trouble — bad picture and network simulator
impair.hint: For testing clients, NVRs and detectors: rain, shaking, covered lens, packet loss, stutter, freezes, bitrate jumps, link outages. Each channel has its own set. Apply restarts only that channel.
impair.rain_tip: Blur, smear, lower contrast, colour fringes, noise
impair.tamper_events: Send Tampering events while shaking / covered
impair.loss_tip: Parts of frames go missing: grey blocks, smearing until the next keyframe
impair.cap: Narrow link: bitrate cap, kbit/s (0 = none)
impair.cap_tip: The picture falls apart into blocks, like on a weak link
impair.outage: Drop the stream now and then (camera unreachable)

diag.name: Name
diag.data: Data (key=value lines; rand:1-100, choice:a|b, seq, now, uuid)
diag.restart: Saved to the file; applies after a restart.
diag.hint_streams: Profiles: 1 = full, 2 = + medium, 3 = + low; quality is derived from the main stream automatically.
diag.hint_kind: Add as many rules as you need, several of the same kind per camera too: each has its own timer and name (sent to ONVIF as Rule).
diag.hint_counting: Counting: every firing adds 1 to Count. Data Step=5 sets the step, Count=rand:0-50 sets the value.
diag.hint_timer: Timer: fixed fires every N units; random draws a new value between From and To every time.

live.title: Live view
live.hint: Live video of your channels right in the browser, no second sign-in. Pick the quality by profile.
